title: Frontier Village (module template)
tagline: Original mini-adventure — copy to content/private/ and adapt for your campaign notes.
sourceNote: No Wizards IP. Use as a scaffold for private modules (e.g. your SKT chapter outlines).

village-social.goal: Learn what attacked the supply wagons.
village-social.starter: Mud and woodsmoke hang over Millhaven. Elder Sarra beckons you from the porch.
village-social.guidance: Village council wants answers; persuasion or insight DC 12.

trail-explore.goal: Follow the trail into the pine scrub and find the raiders' camp sign.
trail-explore.starter: Crushed ferns and wheel ruts lead north. Crows circle somewhere ahead.
trail-explore.guidance: Perception or survival DC 12 to find the ambush point.

bandit-combat.goal: Defeat the bandits and recover the stolen strongbox.
bandit-combat.starter: Three ragged bandits rise from behind fallen pines, blades out.

npcs.name: Sarra
npcs.description: Elder of Millhaven, practical and wary of strangers.
knowledge: Wagons were hit two nights ago on the north trail.
Survivors spoke of tall figures in the treeline — likely exaggeration.

mock.socialSuccess: Sarra exhales. "North trail, two nights past. They took the strongbox and left wheel ruts."
mock.socialFailure: Sarra folds her arms. "Prove you're not part of the problem first."
mock.explorationSuccess: You spot fresh boot prints and a scrap of wagon canvas snagged on a pine branch.
mock.explorationFailure: The scrub all looks the same; you'll need another pass.
mock.canonFactOnSocialSuccess: The raid happened on the north trail two nights ago; a strongbox was stolen.
